personal_crc_diagnosis.definition: Patient has a personal history of colorectal cancer.

personal_crc_age_at_diagnosis_years.definition: Age at diagnosis of the patient's colorectal cancer.

personal_ec_diagnosis.definition: Patient has a personal history of endometrial cancer.

personal_ec_age_at_diagnosis_years.definition: Age at diagnosis of the patient's endometrial cancer.

personal_gc_diagnosis.definition: Patient has a personal history of gastric adenocarcinoma.

personal_gc_age_at_diagnosis_years.definition: Age at diagnosis of the patient's gastric adenocarcinoma.

personal_ls_related_cancer.definition: Patient has a personal history of any Lynch syndrome-related cancer.

personal_ls_related_cancer_age_at_diagno.definition: Age at diagnosis of the earliest Lynch syndrome-related cancer.

personal_multiple_ls_related_cancers.definition: Patient has a synchronous or metachronous Lynch syndrome-related cancer.

personal_dmmr_tumor.definition: Patient has a tumor with mismatch repair deficiency (by PCR, NGS or IHC) diagnosed at any age.

tumor_somatic_pv_with_germline_implicati.definition: A pathogenic or likely pathogenic variant was found on tumor somatic testing that has clinical implications if also present in the germline.

ls_related_cancer_relatives_count.definition: Number of first- or second-degree relatives with a Lynch syndrome-related cancer.

family_ls_pv_known.definition: A Lynch syndrome-associated pathogenic variant is known in the family.

family_ls_pv_test_result.definition: Result of genetic testing of a family member for the familial Lynch syndrome variant.

germline_mgpt_result.definition: Result of germline multigene panel testing (MGPT).

blood_relative_with_known_cancer_gene_pv.definition: Any blood relative has a known pathogenic or likely pathogenic variant in a cancer susceptibility gene.

prior_limited_testing_negative.definition: Previous limited genetic testing (for example single-gene or deletion/duplication analysis) was negative.

interested_in_mgpt.definition: Patient is interested in germline multigene panel testing.

testing_needed_for_surgical_decisions.definition: Germline testing is wanted to aid surgical decision-making and medical management.

cumulative_adenoma_count.definition: Cumulative lifetime number of colorectal adenomatous polyps.

clinical_polyposis_criteria_met.definition: Patient meets colorectal adenomatous polyposis testing criteria (POLYP-1). Clinician determination; the criteria are not stated in the flowchart text.

juvenile_polyp_colon_count.definition: Number of juvenile polyps in the colon.

juvenile_polyps_throughout_gi.definition: Multiple juvenile polyps are found throughout the gastrointestinal tract.

family_jps_close_relative.definition: A first-, second- or third-degree relative has juvenile polyposis syndrome.

family_history_jps.definition: Family history of juvenile polyposis syndrome (JPS), without a stated degree of relationship.

clinical_pjs_criteria_met.definition: Patient meets clinical criteria for Peutz-Jeghers syndrome. Clinician determination.

clinical_sps_criteria_met.definition: Patient meets clinical criteria for serrated polyposis syndrome. Clinician determination.

clinical_lfs_or_cs_phts_criteria_met.definition: Patient meets Li-Fraumeni syndrome or Cowden syndrome/PTEN hamartoma tumor syndrome testing criteria as set out in the referenced breast, ovarian, pancreatic and prostate guideline. Clinician determination.

personal_esophageal_scc.definition: Patient has esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.

personal_esophageal_cancer.definition: Patient has a personal history of esophageal cancer of any histology.

esophageal_scc_hereditary_features.definition: Personal history or examination findings consistent with a hereditary syndrome associated with esophageal SCC (for example Fanconi anemia or tylosis).

known_hereditary_esophageal_scc_syndrome.definition: Patient has a known hereditary syndrome associated with increased risk of esophageal SCC.

family_member_unwilling_or_unavailable_f.definition: The family member who would be the most informative for testing is unwilling or unavailable.

family_eac_or_barretts_relatives_count.definition: Number of family members with esophageal adenocarcinoma and/or Barrett esophagus.

family_early_onset_eac_or_barretts.definition: A family member has esophageal adenocarcinoma and/or Barrett esophagus at an early age.

gastric_cancer_relatives_count.definition: Number of first- or second-degree relatives with gastric cancer.

gastric_relative_youngest_dx_age_years.definition: Age at diagnosis of the youngest relative with gastric cancer.

gastric_relative_confirmed_dgc.definition: At least one relative with gastric cancer has confirmed diffuse gastric cancer (DGC).

personal_dgc_or_t1a_src.definition: Patient has diffuse gastric cancer or stage T1a signet ring cell carcinoma.

family_dgc_history.definition: Family history of diffuse gastric cancer.

fundic_gland_polyp_count.definition: Number of gastric fundic gland polyps.

fundic_gland_polyps_antral_sparing.definition: Fundic gland polyps are restricted to the body and fundus with antral sparing.

colorectal_or_duodenal_polyposis.definition: Patient has colorectal or duodenal polyposis.

personal_gapps_diagnosis.definition: Patient has gastric adenocarcinoma and proximal polyposis of the stomach (GAPPS).

family_gapps_first_degree.definition: A first-degree relative has gastric adenocarcinoma and proximal polyposis of the stomach (GAPPS).

family_first_degree_adenoma_count.definition: Highest reported number of adenomas in a first-degree relative.

affected_fdr_tested_no_pv.definition: The affected first-degree relative has been tested and no pathogenic variant was identified.

affected_fdr_untested_unaffected_relativ.definition: The affected first-degree relative was not tested, and an unaffected individual with the family history was tested with no pathogenic variant identified.

family_known_apc_pv.definition: A pathogenic variant in APC is known in the family.

family_known_mutyh_pv.definition: A pathogenic variant in MUTYH is known in the family.

family_known_cdh1_pv.definition: A pathogenic variant in CDH1 is known in the family.

family_known_apc_promoter1b_pv.definition: A pathogenic variant in the APC promoter 1B is known in the family.

family_known_bmpr1a_pv.definition: A pathogenic variant in BMPR1A is known in the family.

family_known_smad4_pv.definition: A pathogenic variant in SMAD4 is known in the family.

family_cdh1_pv_test_result.definition: Result of genetic testing of a family member for the familial CDH1 pathogenic variant.

family_apc_promoter1b_pv_test_result.definition: Result of genetic testing of a family member for the familial APC promoter 1B pathogenic variant.

germline_mgpt_cdh1_result.definition: Result of germline MGPT including CDH1.

germline_mgpt_apc_promoter1b_result.definition: Result of germline MGPT including the APC promoter 1B.

asymptomatic_family_member_at_risk.definition: Patient is an asymptomatic family member at risk.

individual_apc_test_result.definition: Result of the patient's germline APC testing.

personal_history_classical_fap.definition: Patient has a personal history of classical familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP).

personal_history_attenuated_fap.definition: Patient has a personal history of attenuated familial adenomatous polyposis (AFAP).

clinician_suspects_fap_despite_fewer_pol.definition: Clinician suspects classical FAP although the adenoma count is below 100 (younger age, or family known to have FAP). Clinician determination.

personal_history_map.definition: Patient has a personal history of MUTYH-associated polyposis (MAP).

adenoma_burden_endoscopically_manageable.definition: The adenoma burden can be managed endoscopically (by colonoscopy and polypectomy). Clinician determination.

mutyh_test_result.definition: Germline MUTYH result of the patient.

sibling_of_map_patient.definition: Patient is a sibling of a patient with MAP.

jps_germline_result.definition: Germline result of the patient for BMPR1A and SMAD4 (juvenile polyposis syndrome genes).

index_case_jps_germline_result.definition: Germline BMPR1A and SMAD4 result of the affected index case (proband) in the family.

is_first_degree_relative_of_proband.definition: Patient is a first-degree relative of an affected index case (proband).

relative_bleeding_or_ida_symptoms.definition: First-degree relative has symptoms such as bleeding or iron deficiency anemia.

tumor_somatic_bmpr1a_or_smad4_pv.definition: A BMPR1A or SMAD4 pathogenic or likely pathogenic variant was detected by tumor somatic testing on any tumor type without germline analysis.

stk11_germline_result.definition: Germline STK11 result of the patient.

index_case_stk11_result.definition: Germline STK11 result of the affected index case (proband) in the family.

tumor_somatic_stk11_pv.definition: An STK11 pathogenic or likely pathogenic variant was detected by tumor somatic testing on any tumor type without germline analysis.

germline_pv_gene.definition: The patient's germline pathogenic variant gene and syndrome category, as the cancer-risk-management boxes distinguish them. Use one value per patient.

guideline_section.definition: Which disease or subtype section of this guideline the case belongs to: the disease named in the guideline's page headings that the patient has (e.g. the tumor type or subtype).

small_bowel_polyp_largest_size_mm.definition: Size of the largest small bowel polyp found, in millimetres.

polyps_causing_symptoms.definition: Polyps are causing symptoms in the patient.

new_gi_signs_or_symptoms.definition: Patient has new signs or symptoms of gastrointestinal disease.

fap_phenotype.definition: Classical or attenuated FAP phenotype, from germline APC result and cumulative adenoma count.

meets_familial_gastric_criteria.definition: Meets familial gastric cancer testing criteria (HGAST-1 family history).

gapps_suspected.definition: Suspicion of gastric adenocarcinoma and proximal polyposis of the stomach (GAPPS).

meets_hgast1_testing_criteria.definition: Meets gastric cancer or gastric polyposis testing criteria (HGAST-1).

meets_familial_eac_criteria.definition: Meets criteria for further risk evaluation for esophageal adenocarcinoma (family history).

meets_hesoph1_testing_criteria.definition: Meets esophageal cancer high-risk syndrome or family testing criteria (HESOPH-1).

meets_jps_clinical_criteria.definition: Meets clinical criteria for juvenile polyposis syndrome (JPS).

meets_jps_testing_criteria.definition: Meets juvenile polyposis syndrome (JPS) testing criteria: clinical JPS criteria, or a family history of JPS.

meets_pjs_testing_criteria.definition: Meets Peutz-Jeghers syndrome (PJS) testing criteria: clinical PJS criteria, or a family history of PJS.

notes.predicates: Conditions were drafted and reviewed by a language model (model_reviewed), not by clinicians. 'rejected' means the review rejected the draft; the box then needs clinician judgement. 'section_only' means the box only requires the patient to be in the page's guideline section.
notes.coordinates: bbox and line_bboxes are PDF points with the origin at the page's top left; pages[].size gives the page size.
notes.links: page links name a page id from pages[]; a multi-page code such as PROS-F has ids 'PROS-F 1 of 5' ... ; external_guideline links name another guideline's slug.
notes.reextracted_pages: Pages listed in quality.reextracted_pages were typed as footnote pages (or had no boxes) although they hold flowcharts. Their boxes, arrows and conditions were written from the PDF page by a language-model reviewer (data/<slug>/page_specs/<page>.json, nccn_nav.page_spec) and are not clinician-validated; arrows are image_checked, conditions model_reviewed or none. pages[].kind_before keeps the earlier kind.
